title: Dual-Manifold Variational Autoencoders
abstract: arXiv:2611.23964v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In latent diffusion models, expanding the latent dimension of variational autoencoders (VAEs) is essential to push the upper bound of reconstruction quality. However, without explicit structural constraints, such unregularized expansion easily yields a rugged and ill-conditioned latent manifold, causing generated latents to drift off the manifold during generation (i.e., off-manifold problem). Recent works smooth this manifold by using external foundation models (e.g., DINOv2) as a topological regularizer. However, we argue that tying the latent space to frozen external priors inherently restricts generalization: bound by their pre-training distributions and semantic biases, they may fail to capture faithful visual details on out-of-distribution domains. translated_abstract: 在潜在扩散模型中，扩展变分自编码器（VAE）的潜在维度对于提升重建质量的上限至关重要。然而，在缺乏显式结构约束的情况下，这种未加正则化的扩展容易产生崎岖且病态的潜在流形，导致生成过程中生成的潜在向量漂离流形（即离流形问题）。近期的工作通过使用外部基础模型（例如 DINOv2）作为拓扑正则化器来平滑该流形。然而，我们认为将潜在空间绑定到冻结的外部先验本质上会限制泛化能力：由于受制于这些模型的预训练分布和语义偏差，它们可能无法在分布外领域中捕捉到忠实的视觉细节。我们观察到低维潜在向量天然形成一个更平滑、更有利于生成的流形，因此提出了双流形变分自编码器（DM-VAE），以利用内部表示作为拓扑正则……
tldr: 提出双流形变分自编码器（DM-VAE），利用内部低维潜在表示作为拓扑正则化器来平滑扩展后的高维潜在流形，摆脱对冻结外部基础模型先验的依赖，从而解决离流形问题并提升泛化能力。
en_tdlr: DM-VAE leverages internal low-dimensional latent representations as a topological regularizer to smooth the expanded high-dimensional latent manifold, removing reliance on frozen external foundation-model priors and thereby mitigating the off-manifold problem while improving generalization.
